title: Nested JDBC arrays reach Java aliases with their row structure intact
summary: H2 passed two ragged rows to the Java alias. Both a typed Short[][] result and a second alias returning scalar text preserved the row boundaries.

change.description: H2 extends conversion between SQL ARRAY values and Java arrays for aliased Java function arguments and typed JDBC result reads.

notes: All values fit both Java numeric types. The second alias independently observes the SQL result as its own argument and returns a scalar that bypasses JDBC nested-array result conversion.
